Notification NO.NPSC/EXAM-15/2021 dt. 14.09.2026 (Departmental Examination for Stenographers) 
 Published on : 14-09-2026 04:21 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/EXAM-15/2021 Dated Kohima, the 14th September, 2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 This
is to notify that the Commission will be conducting Speed-Test in Shorthand for
Stenographer Grade II & III for Department Promotion in the Nagaland Public
Service Commission’s Exam Hall tentatively in the 1 st week of December, 2026. 
 1. The
appointing authority may nominate candidates who are regular and confirmed in
service. The nomination letter should reach the undersigned on or before 31 st 
October , 2026 . Applications received after the last date will not
be accepted. 
 2. No candidate will be allowed to appear in
both lower and higher grade simultaneously. 
 3. The list of eligible candidates, examination
routine and further details shall be displayed on the Commission’s Notice Board
and website at https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in in the 2 nd 
week of November, 2026. 
 4. Candidates can opt either to use Computer or
Type-writer for the speed test. Therefore, all the candidates are to mention
their option of using either Computer or Type-Writer in the nomination letter. 
 5. Commission
shall provide shorthand Note Book and Typing papers. Those candidates opting
for Typing should bring their own
Type-writing Machine. They should be
present at the Examination Hall an hour before the commencement of the test. 
 6. It may
be made clear to intending candidates that the success in the Speed Test shall
confer no right of promotion unless that
the candidates is eligible for promotion in all respect. 
 7. Further,
the appointing authorities should ensure that only regular
Stenographers are allowed to sit for Speed-Test. The nomination of the
eligible incumbents should be supported by appointment / promotion order(s). 
 8.The
intending candidates are requested to produce their service
ID card during the Speed Test. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission,
